nodes.name: build.mjs
nodes.summary: Recreates dist, bundles app.js and Supabase dependencies into a minified ES module, and copies the HTML/CSS for static hosting.

nodes.name: server.mjs
nodes.summary: Loopback development server allowing only the built HTML, JavaScript, and stylesheet through GET/HEAD; sends security and no-store headers and rejects other paths/methods.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Complete responsive ledger presentation, including navigation, tables, status badges, modal states, reduced-motion behavior, and print receipt styling.

nodes.name: MANUAL.md
nodes.summary: Human browser acceptance checklist for ledger flows, cloud sign-in, multi-device conflicts, backups, accessibility, and mobile behavior.

nodes.name: cloud-rls.sql
nodes.summary: Transactional database regression script for owner isolation, anonymous denial, stale updates, and invalid payloads. It is source evidence only; not executed by this analysis.

nodes.name: server.test.js
nodes.summary: Starts a synthetic loopback child server to check static allowlisting, security headers, unsupported paths, and write rejection; requires built files and a free port.
